svg.title: Real wiring against four kinds of scrambled wiring, with missing odour data filled two ways
svg.desc: Two panels, left and right hemisphere. For each scrambled control, the real wiring's score difference with missing data set to zero and with missing data filled with averages. With zeros, no comparison reaches the +2.5% benefit margin; with averages, the left hemisphere beats the standard shuffle by 3.38%.
